Choose our 3-Product Bundle (Toothpaste, Mouthwash, Floss) or go all-in with the 4-Product Bundle (includes Gummies) for next-level enamel support, powered by Hydroxamin™—our patent-pending blend of nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamin D3, and vitamin K2.
header.superHtml:
Searching for a fluoride-free option that doesn’t leave your enamel under-protected? The SuperMouth Hydroxyapatite Bundle features Hydroxamin™, our proprietary combination of nano-hydroxyapatite (sometimes called “liquid enamel”), vitamin D3, vitamin K2, xylitol, and prebiotics. This synergy:

  • Helps Strengthen Enamel: Nano-hydroxyapatite can integrate with your teeth’s natural mineral structure.
  • Promotes Mineral Absorption: Vitamins D3 and K2 work together to support effective calcium utilization—vital for stronger teeth.
  • Maintains Oral Balance: Alkaline pH, xylitol, and prebiotics nurture good microbes while discouraging harmful bacteria

And it’s all available in one cohesive flavor—Mint, Strawberry, Vanilla, or Chocolate—so you can enjoy a consistent delicious taste across multiple products.

Choose Your Bundle and Flavor

  • 3-Product Bundle: Perfect for those who want fluoride protection plus the added boost of nano-hydroxyapatite in their brushing, flossing, and rinsing.
  • 4-Product Bundle: Adds our exclusive Hydroxyapatite Gummies for daily, easy nutrient intake—further supporting effective mineral integration into your teeth.

left.text: We are so confident you'll love our customized oral care solutions, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. Experience the best in oral health—risk-free.

items.title: HOW TO USE
items.html:
1. Brush with Hydroxyapatite Toothpaste at least twice daily to coat teeth with “liquid enamel.”
2. Floss daily—removing plaque and delivering active ingredients right where bacteria often hide.
3. Rinse with Mouthwash to balance pH, support beneficial microbes, and freshen breath.
4. Chew Gummies (4-product bundle) for an extra boost of nano-hydroxyapatite, plus vitamins D3 & K2, to support your teeth from within.

reviews.name: May
reviews.title: Working on getting used to new toothpaste
reviews.body: The texture of this toothpaste is very different from the regular commercial toothpaste I am used to.  Brushing does not generate any 'suds' so it felt like I did not properly clean my teeth.  This is also a very expensive product and I am not sure how many people can really afford this.  I am working on trying to get used this product as it is supposed to be good for dental health. Public Reply (Supermouth)

reviews.name: Anonymous
reviews.title: Very pleasantly surprised
reviews.body: I really struggle with mint flavored things so this was a very pleasant surprise. It honestly threw me for a loop bc it tastes nothing like toothpaste normally does. It is sweeter than I anticipated and I kind of wish they offered an unflavored version but so far so good.

reviews.name: Mellisa
reviews.title: Just a hint
reviews.body: The flavoring is very subtle. It taste good. It does a great job. I love the floss and the mouthwash. Make sure your mouth feel refreshed.

reviews.name: Anonymous
reviews.title: WE LOVE SuperMouth products except the strawberry rinse CHANGED
reviews.body: We are thrilled with all SuperMouth products until now and have left great reviews.  I am a hygienist and recommend all SuperMouth products to my patients.  However, this batch of strawberry mouthrinse with fluoride is a bit "off."  The color has changed and it tastes very sweet and not so much like strawberry like it has in the past.  I contacted the company the day we received it several weeks ago but have not heard back so I'm leaving this review.  Sorry, I do not like leaving negative reviews but I'm hoping I will find out why this batch is so different from the delicious strawberry rinse we've received consistently for the past year.  Thank you.
